pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER - auth-proxy | spike of 401s observed on api-prod. metric=auth.401.rate > 5x baseline, unique_src_ips=120, sample_logs=https://logs.internal/xyz (redacted). severity=high. Notify oncall

mike (oncall): I'm on it. paging secops @julia and SRE @nate.

julia (secops): oncall here. can you paste a small log sample? do we see full tokens or just fragments? any customer IDs? :lock:

mike (oncall): sample below (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T12:23:45Z api-prod-05 GET /v1/generate 401 src=52.23.11.4 user-agent="curl/7.79" auth="Bearer aa...snip...xz" tenant_id=acct_14
```
looks like token fragments in debug payloads. shipping level was DEBUG on api-prod-05.

nate (sre): temporarily blocking top 10 offending IPs at edge and disabling debug log level on api-prod-05. also pausing logshipper to elastic for that host.

liz (cs): any sign of customer-visible errors? which tenants impacted? need to assess customer impact and prep comms.

mike (oncall): querying auth logs now - initial scan: ~14 tenant_ids with 401 noise in last 30m, no successful token use observed yet. no 200s that indicate an immediate replay.

julia (secops): treat as suspected token leakage in logs. we need immediate key rotation for affected service accounts and preserve logs for forensics. action plan: 1) rotate svc keys 2) invalidate active sessions 3) stop debug log shipping 4) run wide search for token patterns 5) coordinate CS/legal.

sam (eng): I'll run a staged rotation on staging now and prepare prod rollout. ETA ~20m for canary.

mike (oncall): issuing rotation for service account `ingest-api-svc` with reason="suspected-log-leak" tag=INC-1766543210. calling internal endpoint: `/internal/rotate-keys?svc=ingest-api-svc`.

pagerbot: action log: Key rotation job queued - job_id=rot-8243 initiated by mike (oncall). :white_check_mark:

julia (secops): search query I'm kicking off: `auth.header:/Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,}/` against last 48h. export any matches to forensics bucket s3://incidents/1766543210/forensics. leave originals intact. legal please confirm retention.

legal: confirm - preserve full raw logs for forensics. do not purge. redact copies for external comms. loop in privacy if PII suspected.

nate (sre): disabled debug payloads from api-prod hosts and added a short-term WAF rule to block suspicious user-agent patterns seen in samples. rolling config to 3 regions.

liz (cs): flagged high-touch tenants: AcmeCorp (acct_2) and FinLedger (acct_7). drafting CS note template. will hold send until legal signs off on wording.

sam (eng): staging rotation succeeded. canary validated (no auth regressions). prepping prod rollout in 10m.

mike (oncall): summary: blocked suspect IPs, debug log shipping paused, rotation queued for ingest-api-svc, searching logs for leaked tokens, no confirmed unauthorized access so far. next update in 30m or on completion of rotation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

julia (secops): starting rotation now and running session invalidation for affected tenants. will post when revoke complete. also starting the grep/xfer for matches.

pagerbot: incident status update: acked by oncall (mike), assigned to secops (julia) and SRE (nate). severity=high, customer-impact=potential, next_update=+30m.

mike (oncall): tagging this thread INC-1766543210. staying on call for handoff to oncall@rotation-team after prod rollout.
